freeze_blockers: Qualify independent source, rights and reference denominators and disjoint family components.
Bind development, calibration-only and final evaluation allocation manifest and predeclare thresholds, precision, budgets and primary comparisons.
Qualify exact native parser, solver, runtime and model pins, dependency inventories and offline evidence.
Obtain authorized private restricted corpus and staged-package review evidence for the actual release gate.
Record versioned design and input freeze before confirmatory execution.

claims.text: Orthogonal methods improve auditable conservation and selective decision quality at matched resource and review budgets.
limitations: Hypothesis only; engineering controls and source-asserted development references do not constitute independent evaluation.
Single integrated publication; no source rights, model, canonical pack or dataset admission.
